title: Make taskmaster.dev in /taskmaster-web on the Mjolnir VM
description:

Non-goals: Storybook, Playwright browsers, snapshot deploy, IdentiKey login, kernel SHALLs, multi-instance SQLite, absorbing MetaDev or MetaCoding.

See docs/taskmaster/INTENT.md and .omc/intend/taskmaster-web.md.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] https://taskmaster.dev (or the chosen subdomain) serves the app running in /taskmaster-web on VM 0a0fa094-252f-47b7-b348-6e4624eac9ef
- [ ] One process, one SQLite file, dev mode allowed
